_note: Observed thumbnail language per reference channel, read from boards/t/<channel_id>.jpg (top 5 by views of the newest 250 long videos + 5 newest), collected 2026-11-13. Measured colour statistics per thumbnail are in thumbnail-stats.json. Observation only; nothing here is copied into our thumbnails.

Astrum.subject: one celestial object or probe, full bleed, cinematic render or real image
Astrum.text: 2-4 words, very wide-tracked thin caps, centred ('THIS IS URANUS', 'WHAT WE FOUND', 'TITAN UPDATE')
Astrum.note: recent outlier 'Uranus: The Weirdest Planet' 3.0x median uses 'THIS IS URANUS' over the planet's limb

The Space Race.subject: dramatic landscape of a moon/planet (often exaggerated artistic render), or two leaders' faces for space-politics
The Space Race.text: 'THIS IS X' in heavy white caps with bevel, 2-4 words
The Space Race.background: full bleed; thin white inner border; logo bottom-left
The Space Race.note: exaggerated terrain (Europa spike) = artistic, not data

SEA.subject: star/galaxy/void render
SEA.text: large title words, sometimes mixed weights ('THE LARGEST STAR')
SEA.symbols: scale markers: a tiny ring + arrow labelled 'SOLAR SYSTEM' against a giant star

Kurzgesagt.subject: flat vector illustration, one central subject
Kurzgesagt.text: 2-3 word caps headline at top ('LARGEST STAR', 'WE LOST CONTROL')
Kurzgesagt.symbols: arrow + label for scale ('→ OUR SUN', 'EARTH ↓')
Kurzgesagt.note: illustration brand; not replicable without our own illustration style

History of the Universe.subject: cosmic collage, multiple bubbles/objects; occasional painted face (Einstein)
History of the Universe.text: question or claim in boxed white-outline caps ('THIS IS WHERE IT ENDS.', 'EINSTEIN HATED THIS IDEA.')

ElderFox Documentaries.subject: REAL NASA rover/orbiter imagery, untreated
ElderFox Documentaries.text: short sentence in a thin boxed caption ('Mars In 4K', '15 Months On Mars')
ElderFox Documentaries.symbols: single red arrow pointing at an object in the real image
ElderFox Documentaries.evidence: the real image is the hook
ElderFox Documentaries.note: 'Mars in 4K' 73M = 429x median: real imagery can outperform renders

Sprouts.subject: hand-drawn ink illustration of the concept as a diagram (cycle of figures with arrows)
Sprouts.text: concept name as title ('PYGMALION EFFECT', 'ATTACHMENT THEORY')

PsychToons.subject: faceless bald mannequin figure, glowing brain prop
PsychToons.text: 2-4 words caps, one word in red ('DO IT ANYWAY')

Psych2Go.subject: cute pastel chibi character expressing the emotion

Practical Psychology.subject: old: celebrity photo + huge outlined text; new: flat illustration of a classic experiment
Practical Psychology.text: concept name in a white pill ('EXPERIMENTER BIAS', 'DOUBLE BLIND EXPERIMENT')

Aperture.subject: surreal 3D render: one red figure among blue/grey crowd; open head; levels
Aperture.text: claim in caps ('MOST PEOPLE STUCK HERE', 'THE ONE WHO NEVER POSTS') with arrow
Aperture.symbols: down arrow to the one figure; 'LEVEL 1 | LEVEL 5' split

Nicki Swift.subject: 3-4 cut-out celebrity faces
Nicki Swift.text: yellow/white italic outlined caps ('WHERE ARE THEY NOW?', 'ARE THEY FAKE?!?')
Nicki Swift.note: median of newest 30 only 4.1k on 3.2M subs: list/then-and-now format has collapsed

The List.subject: 2-4 cut-out faces
The List.text: yellow outline caps with a crown or swash

Patrick Cc:.subject: 1-3 large photo-real faces with painterly retouch; props as metaphors (cards 'SCAMMER/FRAUD')
Patrick Cc:.text: 0-4 words; lowercase meme text ('it was all a lie'); recreated social post with date ('Megan Fox ✓ F*CK DISNEY August 31st 2008')
Patrick Cc:.symbols: red falling chart arrow; red circle on a person

SWOOP.subject: host's face centred (consistent persona), subjects either side
SWOOP.text: 3-4 words bottom, one word red ('HE LIED FOR HER')
SWOOP.symbols: yellow arrow to a screenshot/document; red circle on evidence

SunnyV2.subject: digitally painted faces (illustrated), eye-bar censor
SunnyV2.text: big condensed caps or a quote card in quotation marks ('"Netflix was sexist for giving me $11 million..."')

As Told by JP.subject: 1-3 tightly cropped real faces of music stars, dramatic expression
As Told by JP.text: yellow condensed headline at top, opinion ('Icon or A Con?', 'it's worse than you think.')
As Told by JP.note: 35k subs, median 156k (4.5x subs): music-career explainers travel

RealLifeLore.subject: relief map with one country filled red/yellow glow
RealLifeLore.text: white-on-black box caps ('WHY ESCAPE IS NO LONGER POSSIBLE'), 3-6 words
RealLifeLore.symbols: arrows, red Xs on places, a meme face (recent)

Johnny Harris.subject: host face + archival collage; evidence documents; red circle
Johnny Harris.text: 2-4 words, one in red ('WHO IS THE DEEP STATE?')

AI Search.subject: two result images side by side
AI Search.text: one lowercase reaction phrase on a fixed light-blue top band ('this is wild', 'huge AI news')
AI Search.note: rigid template; brand consistency over per-video text

Football Made Simple.subject: manager face (cut-out) + tactical board or broadcast frame with drawn lines
Football Made Simple.text: 1-3 words in a slanted box ('REALITY CHECK', 'JOSE'S MASTERCLASS')
Football Made Simple.symbols: club crests bottom, highlight circles on the pitch

Tifo Football.subject: illustrated player/manager, club crest, map, or table graphic

Law&Crime Network.subject: real photos of the people involved, bodycam frames, mugshots
